profile_text.body:
C3.ai, Inc. is a public company headquartered in Redwood City, CA, trading under the ticker AI. Its SEC Central Index Key is 0001577526. The website listed for the company, airliquide.com, describes Air Liquide as a world leader in gases, technologies and services for industry and healthcare, serving 4.3 million customers and patients across 59 countries with approximately 65,000 employees. The site also announces a research chair titled "Artificial intelligence for chemistry and through chemistry" created by Air Liquide, the École normale supérieure and its Foundation.

No AI products, litigation cases, or MCP servers are listed for C3.ai, Inc. The website content mentions an artificial intelligence research chair but does not describe product offerings.

The company has 281 legal exposure entries in California. No additional litigation cases are recorded.
